services.desc: We are excited to celebrate our bi-annual Festival of Trees, taking place November 23- November 28, 2027. There is something for everyone to enjoy! We also offer a convenient shuttle service from a nearby parking lot to the venue for $5 per car, making transportation to and from the event simple and stress-free. blurb: Imagine arriving in a horse drawn carriage and exchanging vows in our royal garden. Maybe you are dreaming of a wedding in our elegant ceremony space lined with chic gold chairs and adorned with elaborate bouquets of florals or an outdoor cocktail hour before enjoying a gourmet meal and a night of dancing in our magnificent ballroom. Anything is possible at Chateau Nouvelle.
